items.title: Irwin Leclere Interview, 1970-04-14
items.q: I'm very interested in New Orleans piano players and uh like Steve Lewis nobody knows much about him nobody you're the only person I've ever talked to who knew Tom Zimmerman

ctx.x: He started his own club there now. Oh, he did? Yeah, he's back on 52nd Street. They're opening up 52nd Street.

Yeah, I'm happy to hear that. Tony was wonderful. He was named several property units. Oh, I bought Tom Zimmerman. Oh, poor Tom. I'm still here. And Eddie McCarty's gone. Karma Comic is gone. Yeah, isn't that something?
